decisions.reason: The accelerator program is a low-cost branding and deal-flow tool that has stayed on the home page for two years, so it is likely to continue, though it is outside the core machinery business.

The bio-based bitumen binder still has its own page and fits the firm's sustainability positioning, but its market traction is uncertain and the dropped recycling plant shows the firm prunes its portfolio.
The WASTX Cleanic is a core machinery product, prominently promoted with partner ERMAFA and presented in 2024 as the start of a product line, so the firm is unlikely to drop it.
